title: Adding scenarios to courses
intro: Mobbin references for instance and reference semantics, overrides, and post-add sequencing.

questions.title: Instance vs. reference semantics (edits to master propagate? per-course overrides?)
Sequencing after add (drag reorder, grouping into sections, prerequisites between items)

references.title: Reorder lessons and sections in a course
references.question: Q4
references.take: The reorder flow shows lessons moving between named sections while preserving section headers and publish states, directly evidencing post-add grouping and sequence changes.

references.title: Curriculum grouped into numbered sections
references.question: Q4
references.take: The mobile curriculum shows numbered sections, expanded lesson items with durations, and collapsed later sections, preserving hierarchy while keeping the sequence scannable.

references.title: Browse a filtered lesson library
references.question: Q4
references.take: The mobile library flow keeps category chips, search, and filters visible while browsing lessons, then exposes a numbered lesson sequence in the selected course context.

references.title: Attach text to an existing library component
references.question: Q3
references.take: The attach flow searches the library, surfaces an exact match suggestion, previews the existing component, then confirms Attach; it keeps reuse explicit and reviewable at insertion time.

references.title: Import existing content from another course
references.question: Q3
references.take: The flow states that imported content can be edited and rearranged, and visibly supports source selection plus Select all before import; this establishes copied-instance semantics without claiming live master propagation.

references.title: Compare changes between main component and current version
references.question: Q3
references.take: A side-by-side comparison makes changed, added, and removed layers visible before accepting an update; propagation is evidenced in the UI, while per-instance behavior is not assumed.

references.title: Insert a synced block from the advanced blocks menu
references.question: Q3
references.take: The advanced blocks menu exposes Synced block as a reusable content primitive, showing that reuse can be an explicit insertion choice rather than an invisible copy.

references.title: Configure a component instance with properties
references.question: Q3
references.take: Component configuration exposes editable properties and a simplify-instances option, providing a concrete affordance for controlled per-instance customization.

references.title: Curriculum outline with draggable lessons and sections
references.question: Q4
references.take: The outline groups lessons under named sections and exposes New lesson, Bulk upload, and Section summary at each group, supporting sequencing and batching in place.

references.title: Course outline with modules, statuses, and add content
references.question: Q4
references.take: A searchable outline lists modules and lessons with Add content controls plus visible Draft, Published, Drip, and Lock states, making sequence and release constraints inspectable together.

references.title: Course lessons grouped into sections with delayed release
references.question: Q4
references.take: Sections contain ordered lesson rows and show a delayed-release rule on the module, tying grouping and prerequisite-like timing to the outline.
